halt_handoff.text:
HALT_SUCCESS at loop 31 of 32.

All 9 scorecard dimensions at 9.5 with documented accepted residuals. Average 9.5. Build green: 24 suites / 173 tests. Total commits in this run: 31 loops across 18 hours.

Resolved findings (17): F-001 build baseline; F-002/F-005/F-006 persistence injection + factory; F-003/F-009 state package test surface; F-007/F-008/F-010 import-export + filter hooks; F-012 H2H handlers; F-013 PWA timer; F-015 FileReader abort; F-016/F-017/F-018 page-level tests; F-019 selector centralization; F-020 DAG enforcement; F-021 createAppStore factory.

Accepted residuals (4): F-004 TierBoardPage 443 LOC framework-constrained floor; F-011 domain model anemic for backwards-compat with bundled JSON; F-014 createItem smart constructor partial migration (legacy paths preserved); RTK store singleton ambient by convention (createAppStore factory documents).

Residual disposition per dim: architecture_quality (TierBoardPage floor); state_management (H2H idiomatic dep-cluster); data_flow (RTK singleton convention); framework_idioms (as RootState cast); concurrency (single-threaded JS framework-bound async). Domain modeling, simplicity, test strategy, credibility at 9.5 with prior-loop accepted residuals.

Next step options:
  (a) Accept current state — the codebase is contest-grade; current source is the new baseline.
  (b) Push toward 10s — would require structural changes that exceed Simplify Pressure Test (e.g., eject from RTK, framework rewrite); not recommended.
  (c) Reset — /contest-refactor --reset.
